task.prompt:
CONTEXT:
Work in {project_root} on {date}. V719 wrote nine producer primaries and three conductor pre-gate receipts; two producer slots have neither. Static heads and reserved predictions qualified (Exp8334/8335). Local qualification failed three Exp8206 consumer assertions; runtime failed two Exp8307 authority assertions; ARC failed strict typing; cost consumers failed three Exp8329 assertions. GateMate history drifted. The capstone passed its memory checks but failed two branch replays. H1/H2 remain unmeasured. Preserve the frozen V717 science and historical outcomes. Cached observations are exposed development, not current model inference.
EXISTING CODE TO READ FIRST:
CLAUDE.md; CODEX.md; ops/e2e-test-plan.md; ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml; openspec/capabilities/research-reporting/spec.md; openspec/capabilities/verification/spec.md; scripts/experiment_template.py; python/carnot/reporting/primary_publication.py; openspec/change-proposals/research-roadmap-vNEXT.md; openspec/change-proposals/research-roadmap-v719-preserved-20261009.md; openspec/change-proposals/v717-local-learning-protocol.json; results/experiment_8340_v719_runtime_reader_qualification.json; tests/python/test_runtime_change_boundary_8307.py; python/carnot/verify/runtime_change_boundary_8307.py; python/carnot/verify/runtime_change_execution_8307.py; tests/python/test_runtime_localization_8290.py; results/experiment_8307_v717_runtime_change_boundary.json; openspec/change-proposals/research-roadmap-v716-preserved-20261008.md; results/experiment_8326_runtime_reader_qualification.json; python/carnot/reporting/v718_replay_history.py
TASK:
Qualify historical runtime authority before checking changed CUDA evidence. Deliver results/experiment_8353_v720_runtime_reader_qualification.json. Create the thin runner scripts/experiments/experiment_8353_v720_runtime_reader_qualification.py. Store primitive evidence under results/raw/experiment_8353_v720_runtime_reader_qualification/. Future deliverables are dependencies, not existing inputs.
CONCRETE STEPS:
1. PRECONDITIONS: Emit a flushed start line. Authenticate source bytes, terminal sidecars and task authority. Check private scratch, tools and resources before work. Name missing external operands in gate_check_summary. Do not replace natural evidence with fixtures.
2. Emit a flushed progress line at every phase boundary. Emit one before and after every model load, generation, benchmark and subprocess. Print completed/pending counts inside long loops. Poll owned children at least every 60 seconds. Use unbuffered output and bounded deadlines. Keep every silence gap below 600 seconds. Write files over about 200 lines in several tool calls of at most about 150 lines. Send a progress message between calls. No single huge tool call. Do not pad elapsed time.
3. Spec first: add relevant REQ-* and SCENARIO-* before implementation. Write focused failing tests first. Reuse existing modules through small adapters. Preserve assertions, guard thresholds and old evidence. Keep scratch in /tmp and runners in scripts/experiments/. Do not modify research-roadmap.yaml. Freeze validation commands before measurement.
4. Declare no_model_load, MODEL_SPECS=[] and zero current model calls. Identify cached verifier work or artifact aggregation as the inference_substrate. Training small numeric heads is not an LLM load.
5. Reproduce the two failed Exp8340 consumer cases in test_runtime_change_boundary_8307.py: authority activated=False and probe.call_count=0. Its historical Exp8307 reader still bound mutable current authority. Supply preserved V717 design/task bytes for these tests and explicit V720 authority for current qualification. Do not edit the active roadmap or suppress either assertion.
6. Use a complete private historical source closure and real child argv. Require valid old authority, valid current authority, wrong milestone and corrupted contract controls. Run the full frozen consumer command. Set runtime_reader_ready_score only when all owned checks pass. This reader gate is separate from environment change and GPU health.
7. Inspect authenticated driver/library/device/lease changes since the last failed runtime observation. Date and renamed paths are not changes. With no real change, make zero CUDA probes, write complete_blocked_cuda_environment_unchanged and set runtime_changed_score=cuda_context_ready_score=0. Preserve unproved root cause.
8. Only after changed evidence, acquire the existing exclusive lease and run bounded driver/context/allocation/copy checks under the actual child environment. Record UUID and ordinal mapping. No reboot, driver install, reset or termination of unrelated workers. Require context/copy parity for cuda_context_ready_score=1. No model load in this task. Write docs/research-notes/v720-runtime-readiness.md. Run private E2E-018 with explicit historical fixtures.
9. Run relevant unit and consumer tests, scoped Ruff check/format, strict mypy and scripts/check_spec_coverage.py --files <owned-test-files>. Require 100 percent newly owned statements, including real CLI, child and failure paths. Use pytest -n 0 -o addopts= with private scratch. Record argv, exit, timing and log hashes. Do not run the full repository suite inside this experiment.
10. Cold-replay primitive evidence in a fresh process. Run valid, negative and self-consistently rehashed tamper controls. Use unchanged primary_publication checks, scripts/adversarial_verify.py --json <private-candidate> and scripts/verdict_row_consistency_lint.py --strict <private-candidate>. Keep all findings. An exit1 requires the existing typed finding consumer: only independently recomputed informational findings with deliberate-error controls can resolve. Errors, unknown severity, warnings and critical findings block readiness. Do not edit those validators or exemption lists. Publish the terminal primary atomically after checks. Owned failures are disqualified; unchanged external blocks are blocked, never partial. Reconcile openspec/, _bmad/traceability.md, ops/status.md and ops/changelog.md. Do not update generator weights or publish externally.
REQUIRED ARTIFACT FIELDS:
experiment_id, task_id, milestone, run_date: principle: Bind the invocation to its exact authority.
honest_verdict, verdict_class: principle: honest_verdict starts complete_. Class is positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Partial means retryable unfinished owned work only.
gate_check_summary: principle: A block names upstream, path/hash, field, operator, expected and observed values. Missing is distinct from zero.
inference_substrate, inference_substrate_class, MODEL_SPECS, model_invocation_counts, historical_model_provenance: principle: Separate current work from imported inference.
rows, intended_count, completed_count, failed_count, censored_count, excluded_count, independent_count, sample_size_budget: principle: Retain every intended unit and condition. Repeated timings do not add independent sources.
verifier_is_oracle, exposure_scope, independent_generalization_score, generalized_learning_benefit_score: principle: Oracle controls use circular_positive. Both generalization scores remain zero on exposed development.
required_checks_passed, flagged_adversarial, acceptance_gates, validation_receipts, terminal_validation_sidecar_path, adversarial_findings: principle: Readiness requires byte-bound checks, not scientific success.
preconditions_checked, duration_s, phase_spans, random_seed, reproducibility_checksum, source_artifact_hashes, code_config_hashes, raw_shard_hashes: principle: Bind claims to measured work and replayable inputs.
cited_upstream_artifacts, field_principles: principle: List imported evidence and explain every added field.
runtime_reader_ready_score, runtime_changed_score, cuda_context_ready_score: principle: Reader correctness, real change and actual GPU health are independent gates.
historical_fixture_manifest, runtime_identity, lease_receipt, primitive_rows: principle: Preserve exact environment and authority behind each observation.
Run command: cd {project_root} && PYTHONPATH=python:. PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 .venv/bin/python -u scripts/experiments/experiment_8353_v720_runtime_reader_qualification.py --date {date}
Do NOT push. Do NOT modify scripts/research_conductor.py.
